proper_edge_colouring.note: Supplied set map {set G} -> C over an eqType palette, read on the doubletons of actual edges: two distinct edges at a common endpoint get different colours (endpoint form), equivalent to the two corpus edge-pair forms (nonempty intersection / not disjoint). Values off E(G) are irrelevant; labels are kept, injective relabelling preserves and reflects properness; the domain is inhabited for every graph, so no map into an empty palette exists.

proper_pair_edge_colouring.note: Supplied ordered-pair map G -> G -> C over an eqType palette, symmetric on ALL pairs (adjacent or not), with different colours on two distinct neighbours of a vertex. The empty graph admits every pair map, the one into an empty palette included; a nonempty edgeless graph admits no map into an empty palette (K_1 needs one colour); constant maps are proper on K_2 and improper on K_3.

proper_ecolouring.note: Public adapter kept under its old name: a transparent alias of GTBase.edge_colourings.proper_edge_colouring with the same eqType palette generality (proper_ecolouringE).
